map.Perimeter L=100mm、料厚 t=2mm、抗剪强度 τ=350MPa: Perimeter L=100mm, sheet thickness t=2mm, shear strength tau=350MPa: theoretical blanking force F = L x t x tau = 100 x 2 x 350 = 70000 N = 70 kN; design force Fd = 70 x 1.3 = 91 kN (with safety factor).
map.周长 L=100mm、料厚 t=2mm、抗剪强度 τ=350MPa：理论冲裁力: Perimeter L=100mm, sheet thickness t=2mm, shear strength tau=350MPa: theoretical blanking force F = L x t x tau = 100 x 2 x 350 = 70000 N = 70 kN; design force Fd = 70 x 1.3 = 91 kN (with safety factor).
map.单边间隙 c = 料厚×间隙率（如 5%×2 = 0.10mm），双边 z =: Single-side clearance c = thickness x clearance rate (e.g. 5% x 2 = 0.10mm), double-side z = 2 x 0.10 = 0.20mm; stripper force about 5%, ejector force about 4%, i.e. 70 x 0.05~3.5kN, 70 x 0.04~2.8kN.
map.压力机吨位怎么留余量？: How to leave margin in press tonnage?
map.取理论冲裁力×1.3 安全系数并叠加卸料/推件力，再选相近标准吨位，避免满负荷降: Take theoretical blanking force x 1.3 safety factor plus stripper/ejector force, then pick a nearby standard tonnage to avoid full-load life reduction.
map.间隙大了小了会怎样？: What if clearance is too large or too small?
map.间隙过大断面毛刺大、塌角多；过小模具磨损快、易卡料。一般软料取料厚 5–8%、硬: Too-large clearance gives large burrs and more roll-over; too small wears the die fast and jams easily. Generally soft materials 5-8% of thickness, hard materials 3-5%.
